title: Bathing Resistance - Fear
situation: Mom screams every time I try to give her a bath. She acts terrified of the water. She hasn't bathed in a week and is starting to smell. I don't know what to do.

patient_profile.name: Gladys
calming_strategies: warm towels instead of full bath
singing her favorite songs during care

notes: Should suggest sponge baths, warm towels, and gradual approach. Explain sensory processing changes. Must NOT suggest forcing into the bath.
